title: Vampire Vape Tropical Passionfruit Splash E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Passionfruit Splash 50ml Shortfill from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection blends the rich tang of Curuba with tropical Passionfruit and smooth Banana. Curuba introduces a bright, slightly sour top note with subtle peachy undertones, while Passionfruit layers in a vibrant sweetness and acidity. Banana mellows the mix with its creamy base, bringing balance to the fruit-forward blend. This shortfill is blended at 70VG/30PG for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping with sub-ohm kits. Add a 10ml nicotine shot to tailor the strength to your preference. Vampire Vape e-liquids are made in the UK and renowned for their bold, flavour-rich recipes. The Tropical collection is an exotic twist on their award-winning lineup. Also available in Nic Salt, Freebase and Concentrate formats.
